description: Return the contents of one bundled file (script, reference or template) of a skill returned by load_skill. Pass the skill id and the file path as listed ("SKILL.md" returns the full SKILL.md).

id.description: The skill id load_skill returned, e.g. "skill:owner/repo#slug".

path.description: The file path as listed under "Bundled files", relative to the skill folder (e.g. "scripts/check.py").

name: read_skill_file
